## Skills (26 Total)

Located in `.agents/` - Load via @skill-name syntax

### Core Architecture
- @kmp-critical-patterns - 6 core patterns (ViewModel, Either, Impl+Factory, Navigation, Testing, Plugins)
- @kmp-architecture - Module structure, vertical slicing, feature boundaries
- @kmp-domain - Domain models, use cases, domain exceptions
- @kmp-di - Koin dependency injection patterns and configuration
- @kmp-gradle - Convention plugins, build configuration

### Layer Implementation
- @kmp-presentation - ViewModels, lifecycle, SavedStateHandle, UI state management
- @kmp-data-layer - Repository patterns, Either<RepoError,T>, DTO mapping
- @kmp-api-services - Ktor Client, API services, DTOs
- @kmp-testing-patterns - Kotest, MockK, Turbine, property-based testing

### Platform & Design
- @kmp-ios - SwiftUI + KMP ViewModels Direct Integration, framework exports
- @kmp-navigation - Navigation 3 modular architecture, scoped routes, type-safe
- @kmp-design-systems - Design tokens, component library, icon strategy

### Specialized
- @kmp-compose-unstyled - Headless components, Compose Unstyled patterns
- @kmp-desktop - JVM-specific patterns, SavedStateHandle, Koin configuration
- @kmp-testing-strategy - Testing philosophy, coverage guidelines, test planning
- @kmp-commands - CLI reference, build commands, validation scripts

### Development
- @kmp-developer - General development, feature implementation, bug fixes
- @kmp-mobile-expert - ViewModels, repositories, iOS integration, Either patterns
- @compose-screen - Compose UI screens, Material Design 3, responsive layouts
- @swiftui-screen - SwiftUI iOS screens, StateFlow bridging, lifecycle management
- @ktor-backend - Ktor server endpoints, REST APIs, request validation

### Design & Planning
- @product-designer - Product requirements, acceptance criteria, MVP planning
- @ui-ux-designer - Visual design, animations, interaction patterns
- @onboarding - First-run experience, user onboarding flows
- @user-flows - User journeys, navigation contracts, UX flows

### Quality
- @docs-maintainer - Documentation updates, link validation, content consolidation

## Agent Routing

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - Decision trees for skill selection by task domain
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) - Documentation index for additional references

## For AI Agents

**Load skills for specialized tasks:**
```
Load @skill-name to access domain-specific knowledge and workflows
Example: @kmp-presentation for ViewModel patterns, @compose-screen for UI implementation
```

**Workflow:**
1. **Identify task domain** → Check AGENTS.md decision trees
2. **Load relevant skill(s)** → Use @skill-name syntax to load specialized guidance
3. **Start with quick reference** → @kmp-critical-patterns for 6 core patterns
4. **Domain-specific loading** → Load skills based on implementation area:
   - Architecture/Planning → @kmp-architecture, @product-designer
   - ViewModel/Presentation → @kmp-presentation, @kmp-mobile-expert
   - Data/Repository → @kmp-data-layer, @kmp-api-services
   - UI Implementation → @compose-screen, @swiftui-screen, @ui-ux-designer
   - Testing → @kmp-testing-strategy, @kmp-testing-patterns
   - iOS → @kmp-ios, @swiftui-screen
   - Navigation → @kmp-navigation
   - DI/Wiring → @kmp-di, @kmp-commands

**Validation:**
```bash
./gradlew :composeApp:assembleDebug test --continue
```
